verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a developer platform with a CLI like Wrangler, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry collection, usage tracking, or any opt-out mechanism. The built-in observability and AI Gateway metrics cover the user's own application data, not vendor telemetry about the user, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
